title: Plasticity in graph metric spaces and their hyperspaces
summary: A metric space is plastic if every bijective nonexpansive self-map is an isometry. We prove that the hyperspace of nonempty compact subsets of every connected, locally finite, regular graph, equipped with the Hausdorff metric associated with the path metric, is plastic. The proof identifies the sets with smallest unit balls as the nonempty subsets of adjacent-twin classes and shows that every nonexpansive bijection induces an automorphism of the quotient graph preserving the sizes of these classes.
